title: FLA import: morph (shape tween) style decoding is unverified — CMorphSegment styleFlags used as fill1, fill0Style/fill1Style captured but ignored, morph fill/stroke tables skipped, end shape reuses start styles
description: decodeMorphData (flash8-binary.ts:3203-3400) reconstructs shape-tween end geometry from CPicMorphShape but its style handling is internally suspicious and fixture-underdetermined: (a) the CMorphSegment field mapping (:3286-3304) reads styleFlags, fill0Style, fill1Style then assigns fill0 = fill0Style but fill1 = styleFlags — using the FLAGS word as a fill index — with fill1Style explicitly voided ('may be useful for future refinement'); a multi-fill morph would attach wrong fills to end-shape edges. (b) the morph FILL/STROKE tables that follow the segment list (:3364-3394) are length-consumed but their contents discarded; the end shape is built with the START keyframe's fills/strokes verbatim (:3350-3359), so a tween whose end fill color/gradient differs imports with the start styles on both keyframes when the end CPicFrame carries no own shape. (c) CMorphCurve's two trailing s32s are unknown1/unknown2 (:3324-3325, one 'observed to be a style index; ignored'). docs/21 sec 13 describes a materially different record layout (see docs-accuracy task 1407), so neither source is authoritative. STATUS: partially verifiable now — packages/core/fixtures/morph-shape-tween-mx.fla exists and can pin the single-style case; a MULTI-style / color-changing morph needs a new real-Flash fixture (mark unconfirmed until then). Why it matters: shape-tween import fidelity for anything beyond one solid fill; also feeds the 1386(f) write side (morphTag always 0) — a correct reader is the inverse oracle the writer will be round-tripped against. Fix: decode the morph fill/stroke tables (layouts in flacomdoc TimelineConverter ~line 2983 per the existing comment) into end-shape styles, correct the segment style-index mapping against the fixture, and document the two unknown s32s. Acceptance: import test on morph-shape-tween-mx.fla asserting end-keyframe geometry AND styles; a regression test that a synthetic multi-fill morph maps fill indices per the corrected layout; items needing a new fixture explicitly skipped-with-reason via the fla8-fixture guard pattern.
